name: curl-impersonate-bridge
description: curl-impersonate 桥 (R29-1B): curl_cffi(Python curl-impersonate 绑定)TLS 指纹模拟 —— 模拟 Chrome/Firefox/Safari 真实 TLS ClientHello(JA3/JA4) + HTTP/2 SETTINGS 帧指纹 + 浏览器头组顺序, 绕过 WAF 按 TLS 指纹封锁。仅绑定 127.0.0.1:3018, 引擎 fetcher.ts 在 fetchViaCurl(OpenSSL 栈)被 JA3-strict WAF 拦截后, 调用本桥用 curl_cffi 重发请求。安装: uv venv .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python curl_cffi && (可选).venv/bin/python -c 'from curl_cffi import requests' 自检。无 .venv / curl_cffi 未装时 /health 返回 {ok:true, curlCffiAvailable:false}, 引擎侧 checkCurlImpersonateBridge() 缓存 60s 内视为不可用, 自动跳过该级降级链(零回归)

scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python server.py; else exec python3 server.py; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python server.py; else exec python3 server.py; fi'
